content: Gwae hegehegedi tosaweyana weyahina

Muliyetega wete Yesu ꞌihila hola Galili papalina sabi heꞌita, ma boda madou hedade siꞌetoꞌautama, ꞌoinega Yesu waga ꞌaigeda ꞌiꞌahaꞌahai holai ꞌoina ꞌigeluwa, ꞌimiyatoiya, ma boda madouna sitoholowa ꞌoyaꞌoya.
Ma Yesu gwae hegehegedi baibaiwana ꞌoidiyega ꞌiheꞌita ꞌoidiya, ꞌigwaeya,
“Wahesagoha: Tobegula ꞌaigeda ꞌina tanoha ꞌinaowa ma witi patuna ꞌisaweyanediya,
ma tupwana patu ꞌedai sibeꞌuwa, ma bwasumo siꞌitediya, ta sitowa dobiya ma siꞌaidiya.
Ma tupwana patu baleꞌu lodaꞌudaꞌuleina ꞌoina sibeꞌuwa ma sibwala mwayamwayauwa, weyahina baleꞌuina ꞌiꞌiuna,
ꞌoinega hala ꞌiꞌalasidiya ma siwelaiya, weyahina geya baleꞌu gogaina siloba.
Ma tupwadi patu talitali ꞌoidiya sibeꞌuwa ma sibwala hebwehebweliya, ma geya sowasowahina ma patuwedi sihuwa, weyahina talitali ꞌihewaiwaiya ta ꞌisahila heꞌamasidiya.
Ma hesi tupwana patu baleꞌu bwebweꞌana ꞌoina sibeꞌuwa, ma sibwalama sihemadouwa ma sihuwa, ma tupwana patuwedi huwaidi ꞌadi baibaiwa teti, ma tupwadi sikisiti, ma wete tupwadi handeledi.
“Ceguma matenami, gwae bewa wahesagohe.”
Toꞌaha weyahina gwae hegehegedi

Muliyetega boda sisawala ma Yesu ꞌiboinamo, ma tupwadi tomota ma ꞌana tomuliyao site tuwelowedi baꞌidadiyao sinaoma, ma Yesu ꞌoina sihesilala, sigwaeya, “Cino gwae hegehegedi toꞌaha ꞌana nuwasabwalena?”

Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Comi moisa Yehoba ꞌoimiya ꞌitagwala ma ꞌina loina huhuna ꞌana tosanapuwao, ma hesi tomota baibaiwadi nuwadi ꞌiꞌelopota ma gwae hegehegedimo sihehesagohe, ma ꞌana nuwasabwalena ꞌabwa geya sisanapu, ma wete ꞌana sanapu siꞌebeꞌebese ma geyaꞌabwa silobaloba. Coinega wete geyaꞌabwa ꞌidi puiyao ꞌoidiyega sinuwanuwabui ma geyaꞌabwa Yehoba ꞌinuwanuwa samudi.”
Tosaweyana ꞌana lihasa
Ma Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Togidega, ꞌigu gwae hegehegediyedi ꞌadi sanapu geya ꞌoimiya, ꞌawa? Ma togidega tupwadi gwae hegehegedi bewa gide wada sanapu ꞌesedi?
Tobegulaina Yehoba ꞌina gwae gide patu ꞌisaweyaneya.
Tupwadi patuwedi sibeꞌuwa ꞌedai, gide tomotaedi Yehoba ꞌina gwae sihesagoheya, ma Seitani ꞌinaoma eema gwaeina ꞌoidiyega ꞌiꞌewa yahulediya.
“Wete gide patuwedi baleꞌu lodaꞌudaꞌuleina ꞌoidiya sibeꞌuwa, ꞌadi sanapu ꞌabehega ꞌeguma tomotaedi Yehoba ꞌina gwae sihesagoheya ma maꞌidi yaliyaya sitagwala,

ma hesi geya walowalodi paꞌalidi ꞌilagudi, ꞌoinega sauga ꞌiꞌiuna tuwa simiyamiya, ma ꞌabwa to sauga ꞌoina Yehoba ꞌina gwae ꞌana hemisa weyahina mwau nuwana ꞌaleha siloba, beno ꞌoina sibeꞌu mwayamwayau.
“Ma patuwedi taudi talitali ꞌoidiya sibeꞌuwa ꞌadi sanapu ꞌabehega tomotaedi taudi Yehoba ꞌina gwae sihesagoheya,
ma hesi ꞌidi nuwatuhu baleꞌu ma wasawasa weyahidi, ꞌoidiyega Yehoba ꞌina gwae siloheꞌamasiya, ma geya sowasowahina huwaidi silagu.

“Ma ꞌane patuwedi baleꞌu bwebweꞌana ꞌoina sibeꞌuwa, ꞌana nuwasabwalena ꞌabehega tomotaedi taudi maꞌidi tagwala moisa Yehoba ꞌina gwae sihesagoheya, ꞌoinega huwaidi bwebweꞌadi ma baibaiwadi ꞌilagudiya. Tupwadi huwaidiyao teti, ma tupwadi sikisiti, ma tupwadi handeledi.”
Gwae hegehegedi mayale weyahina
Ma Yesu ꞌoidiya ꞌigwaeya, “Geyaꞌabwa mayale ꞌasiꞌasilalaina taꞌahusam walata nuwana sita ꞌoidiya, ma hesi ꞌatamana talagu ma ꞌiꞌasilala,
ma ꞌoinega toꞌaha ꞌatemiya wadahwediya ꞌabwa ꞌasilalaina ꞌiꞌabihe latuhedi ma taꞌitadi.
Ceguma matenami, gwae bewa wahesagohedi.”
Ma wete ꞌihegwaediya, “Wanuwatuhuyahi ma gwae wahesagohe bwaibwaini, weyahina toꞌaha ꞌomi ꞌimi ꞌebwaya, wete gide maisa waꞌewa, ma hesi ma ꞌana loheposeyana.

Weyahina ꞌeguma taiya Yehoba ꞌina tobwatobwa ꞌoina ꞌimiyamiya, tobwatobwaina ꞌiloheposeyane. Ma ꞌeguma taiya geya Yehoba ꞌina tobwatobwa ꞌoina, eema toꞌaha bwebweꞌana ꞌoina ꞌimiyamiya Yehoba ꞌabwa ꞌoinega ꞌiꞌewa yahuledi.”
Gwae hegehegedi hewana weyahina
Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Yehoba ꞌina loina tomota ꞌoidiya gidemusa hewana loheya ꞌina tanoha ꞌidauniya,
ma loheyaina ꞌiꞌenowa ma ꞌitoholo sabwelo ma nihuwana, ma hewanaina sibwalabwala ma sipilipili, ma hesi ꞌidi bwalaina ꞌana lamu geya ꞌida sanapuya.
Weyahina baleꞌu ꞌiloiloina ꞌidi bwala ma ꞌidi huwa weyahina.
Ma muliyetega ꞌabwa huwaina ꞌimatuha, ꞌoinega toni tanohaina ꞌiheꞌale ꞌetahi.”
Gwae hegehegedi patu ꞌiꞌiuna weyahina
Yesu wete ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Togidega Yehoba ꞌina hetoloina ꞌana gwae hegehegedi yaꞌabi heꞌasilala ꞌese ꞌoimiya?
Nuwana gide ꞌaigeda ꞌaiwe patuna, ꞌoina yagwaebala, beno seyala,* weyahina seyala patuna ꞌiꞌiuna,
ma ꞌeguma taꞌuma ma ꞌibwala ma ꞌiheꞌaiwe ma lahanao madoudi ꞌilagudi, ma laganaowedi logulogudi ꞌoidiya bwasumowao ꞌidi nehwa siꞌabidi.”
Yesu ꞌina gwae hegehegedi baibaiwana
Yesu ꞌina guguya ꞌoina gwae hegehegedi baibaiwadi wete ꞌoidiyega ꞌiheheꞌita. Ceguma tomota ꞌoidiya ꞌimeyameyahana, ma sida sanapu.
Weyahina tauna sauga baibaiwana gwae hegehegediyega ꞌilologuguya boda ꞌoidiya, ma ꞌana tomuliyaomo ꞌoidiya gwae hegehegediyedi ꞌilihalihasidi.
Yesu yaumai ma dibana ꞌiloinaediya
Lahilahiya Yesu ꞌina heꞌita wagai ꞌilosalohiya, ta ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌihegwaediya, “Wagelu ma tahabala hali tupwa.”
Eeta sigeluwa ma sihabala ma boda holai siꞌebesinediya, ma tupwadi wete wagaina simulimuliye.
Ma wediliya madouna silobeya, ta dibana wagai ꞌisiwasiwa taona ma ꞌiꞌiuna sidamana.
Ma Yesu waga gwahuna ꞌana ꞌulide ꞌilaguya ma ꞌiꞌeno sineya, ma ꞌana tomuliyao silohanohanoya ma sigwaeya, “Bada, ꞌutoholo ma ꞌulememai; ꞌiꞌiuna ꞌaꞌamasa.”
Ma Yesu ꞌitoholowa, ta yaumai ma dibana ꞌiloinaediya, ꞌigwae, “Tuwa! Cuꞌemutugo ma ꞌudaumwala.” Coinega yaumai ꞌilolaguwa ma hola mabwaiyana ꞌidaumwala.
Ma ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Toꞌaha weyahina waꞌateyohowa? Togidega ta geya ꞌimi hemisamo?”
Ma nuwadi ꞌihepwanopwanowa ma siꞌateyohowa, ma siboidimo ꞌoidiya sigwaeya, “Loheya toꞌatoꞌaha bewa, yaumai ma dibana ꞌenana simuliyeya?”
